events.factual_description: World Music Institute presents L. Shankar with Selvaganesh Vinayakram and Amit Kavthekar in its Masters Series on Friday, September 18, 2026 at Adler Hall in the New York Society for Ethical Culture. Doors are at 7:00 PM and the performance begins at 8:00 PM. WMI identifies Shankar as a pioneer of East-West fusion, co-founder of Shakti with John McLaughlin, and creator of a 10-string stereophonic double violin; the announced trio places that instrument and voice alongside kanjira, mridangam, konnakol and tabla.

en.why_it_matters: The reason to care is the instrumental conversation, not merely the Shakti name. Shankar's electric double violin can cover an unusually broad register while Selvaganesh and Kavthekar create two distinct South Indian and tabla-based rhythmic vocabularies around it. The direct Shakti lineage matters, but so does hearing that lineage carried by a still-active instrumental voice rather than reconstructed as a repertory tribute.
en.trip_verdict: Actively prioritize this if a New York trip overlaps. The trio is strong enough to build one city night around, especially for violin, percussion and Indo-jazz fusion, while the adjacent Somerville appearance on the same run means there is no need to treat the New York stop as a singular alter-the-trip event.

es.why_it_matters: Lo importante es la conversación instrumental, no solamente el nombre de Shakti. El violín eléctrico doble de Shankar cubre un registro fuera de lo normal, mientras Selvaganesh y Kavthekar construyen a su alrededor dos vocabularios rítmicos distintos desde la percusión del sur de India y la tabla. La línea directa con Shakti pesa, pero pesa todavía más escucharla en una voz instrumental que sigue activa y no como una reconstrucción de repertorio.
es.trip_verdict: Sí lo priorizaría activamente si coincide con un viaje a Nueva York. El trío alcanza para construir una noche de la ciudad alrededor del concierto, sobre todo si importan violín, percusión e indo-jazz, pero la actuación de Somerville del día anterior dentro de la misma corrida evita tratar esta parada como un acontecimiento singular que obligue a rehacer el viaje.

events.factual_description: Blue Note Tokyo presents Till Brönner's ITALIA on September 10-13, 2026. September 10-11 have 6:00 PM and 8:30 PM sets; September 12-13 have 4:30 PM and 7:30 PM sets. The six-member band is built around Brönner's 2025 album Italia, produced with Nicola Conte as a homage to Italian music from the 1960s through the early 1980s. Blue Note Tokyo describes this as Brönner's awaited return as leader; its own related-performance history shows his previous leader engagement there in December 2019.

en.why_it_matters: This is a current-project date rather than a generic return by a prominent European trumpeter. Brönner brings trumpet, flugelhorn and voice into the Italia concept, with Nicola Conte's production framework drawing on Italian music from the 1960s through the early 1980s. The six-piece setting gives the project enough harmonic and rhythmic room to be more than a polished songbook exercise, and it marks Brönner's return as a Blue Note Tokyo leader after his 2019 engagement.
en.trip_verdict: Actively make room for one set if your Tokyo dates overlap. Four nights provide flexibility, so this works as a strong city-night anchor rather than a scarce event that should displace a rarer master, premiere or one-off elsewhere in the itinerary.

es.why_it_matters: Ésta es una fecha de proyecto actual, no simplemente el regreso de un trompetista europeo importante. Brönner mete trompeta, flugelhorn y voz dentro del concepto de Italia, con el marco de producción de Nicola Conte mirando a la música italiana de los sesenta a principios de los ochenta. El sexteto le da suficiente espacio armónico y rítmico para que no se vuelva un ejercicio pulido de cancionero, y además marca su regreso como líder a Blue Note Tokyo después de su residencia de 2019.
es.trip_verdict: Sí le haría espacio activamente a un set si coincide con tus días en Tokio. Las cuatro noches dan margen, así que funciona como una ancla fuerte para una noche en la ciudad sin desplazar una rareza mayor, un estreno o un one-off dentro del itinerario.
